title: Kristin D NDE 3782
date: 'multiple times, don't know the exact dates though'
content: I feel so tacky saying this since it's so stereotypical, but there was always a bright white light. I'd go to it, and once I got there, and I touched it, everything was beautifully white, scintillating, and warm. It smelled sweet and inviting, like cupcakes or warm vanilla sugar. There were these - the phrase used on the site was 'unearthly beings', and they talked to me. The specifics of what they said are hazy. There was a lot of talking about how special I was, how people like me didn't come around often, and that I'd understand and remember more, as I got older when it was important again. I have no idea what they were referring to, only that it made me feel like the most important person in the world (also I was beaten up on a lot as a kid, so positive attention is the thing that I've always craved most). I do distinctly remember that they told me at the end of each time that it was time to go home. I always wanted to stay, but they said that I had important work to do and that they'd see me again soon, and then the last time it was someday. Everything started to fade away, and then it would be black. Then there was a shock feeling, like suddenly being submersed in cold water, or unknowingly grabbing an electric fence. Each shock came with a sort of cold, fluorescent light flash, and then I'd be back in my body. I was both, happy to have been complimented and sad to leave. They must have told me something about church, but I don't think it was any sort of 'you should go to church', but it wasn't against it really either. Church was just mentioned, because that's actually, why I talked to my mom about what had happened. I remembered the word 'church' and I asked her what that was. She asked why I wanted to know and I told her. I guess I didn't realize it wasn't something that happened to everyone, because she said that I was really casual about it. I got confused when she didn't know what I was talking about. That's about all I can tell you.

arrival.other_being_detail: “unearthly beings”, who talked to her; specifics hazy.

environment.environment_other_detail: Everything was “beautifully white, scintillating, and warm.” Smelled “sweet and inviting, like cupcakes or warm vanilla sugar.”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Experience faded to black; then a “shock feeling” (like cold water or electric fence) with a cold fluorescent light flash, then back in body.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she had “important work to do.”

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated experiences; “shock” return with cold fluorescent flash.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel described; goes to bright white light, meets beings/communicates, told to go home due to important work, fades to black, shock/flash, returns to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Occurred “multiple times”; each time told it was time to go home; last time told they’d see her again “someday.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Strong sensory smell described: “cupcakes or warm vanilla sugar.” Return involved a distinct “shock feeling” with a cold fluorescent light flash.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Everything was beautifully white, scintillating, and warm. It smelled sweet and inviting, like cupcakes or warm vanilla sugar.” “It was time to go home.” “I had important work to do and that they'd see me again soon, and then the last time it was someday.”
